protocol.scope: Historical public trial outcome reanalysis; not validation of the independent Rust process model or a farmer-specific forecast
protocol.primary_comparison: Marsden 3-year system minus 2-year system, corn and soybean phases separately
protocol.reason: Oats replaced triticale starting in 2006; common coverage for existing corn and soybean records; six chronological years on each side
protocol.corn_unit: Verify author-processed dry Mg/ha against pinned raw workbook; divide by (1-0.155) to express grain at 15.5% moisture, then use 0.06277 Mg/ha per bu/ac where needed
protocol.soy_unit: Reported bu/ac at 13% moisture; retain source conversion 0.06719 Mg/ha per bu/ac
protocol.pairing: Same crop, year and replicate block, exactly one record per system after declared author subplot aggregation
protocol.management: Whole management-system contrasts, including manure/fertilizer/herbicide/tillage and subplot aggregation; not an isolated clover or rotation-sequence causal effect
historical_contrast_baselines: Predict held-out annual contrast as zero
Predict held-out annual contrast as mean paired annual difference in training years
metrics: fraction of years with positive contrast
protocol.uncertainty: Descriptive percentile bootstrap of whole years (10000 resamples, seed 7112026), averaging all four blocks before resampling. Conditional on one experiment and its four blocks, not a field prediction interval or full site-to-site uncertainty.
protocol.holdout_rule: No parameter changes or train/test ratio changes after held-out contrast scores are calculated
protocol.pfi_role: Independent published 2022 strip-trial summaries with four replicated strips per treatment; no fabricated raw replicates or p-values; original LSD and significance labels retained
protocol.water_rule: Moisture state and qualitative seasonal patterns are not ET, irrigation saving or a water balance. Sensor failures and conflicting dates remain explicit.
protocol.economics_rule: Published historic net returns retain their definition and vintage; no transfer to current farm profit. Any new break-even calculation uses explicit conditional costs and prices, separate from observed trial effects.
protocol.NASA_role: Existing POWER historical regional context may stratify descriptive weather exposure only. No exact field coordinates invented for public farms and no satellite proxy relabeled as ground truth.
protocol.human_testing: Not performed; real farmer participation unavailable in this round. Supply protocol, blank records, facilitator tool and analysis without synthetic human results.

marsden.unit_note: Corn dry Mg/ha divided by 0.845, then converted with 0.06277 Mg/ha per bu/ac; soy at 13% moisture, 0.06719 conversion. Do not compare dry and moist grain directly.

limits: One experiment, four repeatedly sampled blocks. Bootstrap intervals condition on these blocks.
Management-system contrast and author averaging over split herbicide treatments; not pure red-clover causality.
Historical crop-phase yield contrast is not whole-rotation annual revenue.
Backtest concerns an empirical contrast benchmark, not the Rust or APSIM process model.
Complete verified event-level management, soil hydraulic profile, oat phase output and line-item economics are not closed.

Original corn workbook uses an approximate 0.06271 mass/bushel conversion; declared standardized analysis uses 0.06277, a 0.096% convention difference. Later soybean harvest records are audited but excluded from fitting pending management metadata review.

pfi.transcription_check: Tables 1–3 visually checked against PDF pages 2–3 on 2026-11-15; one analyst, not an independent double extraction
pfi.design: Alternating paired strips, four replications of each treatment on each farm. Random allocation is not established by the report. Raw replicate yields and sensor time series were not acquired.

The conclusion's Ose no-yield-effect statement conflicts with Table 3 and the Results, which report a significant 11 bu/ac corn reduction. Retain Table 3 values and flag the contradiction.
Cannon's rounded difference and LSD both equal 1 bu/ac while the table marks significance. Retain the author's label; rounded summaries cannot recreate the original test.
